# Nura

> Nura is an AI health and wellbeing companion, made by Zapx Labs, that checks in on you. It gets to know how you're sleeping, feeling and getting on, keeps a simple Care plan around your day, and checks in by message, WhatsApp or a short call. Not to be confused with other products called Nura.

Most of looking after yourself happens on ordinary days: sleep, stress, energy, habits, and the people you look out for. Nura is a companion for that. It remembers what you said mattered, can read your sleep and steps from Apple Health or Health Connect if you choose, and checks in. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional care, and you decide what it remembers.

## How it works

1. Tell Nura what's going on in plain words: how you're sleeping, what's stressing you, a habit you want to keep, or someone you look out for.
2. It keeps a simple Care plan, so what matters to you stays in one place.
3. It checks in on you by message, WhatsApp or a short call, at the times that suit you.

## Free tools

Free tools that run in your browser, with no sign-up. Nothing you type is uploaded.

- [Printable medicine schedule maker](https://usenura.app/tools/medicine-schedule): add each medicine, dose, times of day and days, and print a weekly tick-box chart (A4 or US Letter) or save it as a PDF. A personal reminder chart, not medical advice; it has no drug data and gives no dose advice.
